text:
leo: Heads up — proposing a stratified enable for atlas-13b tomorrow 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. Strategy: tiny canary (3%), medium ramp (20%), full (77%). Asking for quick alignment on gating rules, variant fallback ordering, and a single "circuit-pin" rollback command we can run from pager duty.

pasha: thumbs up to stratified. Suggested telemetry gates: p95 latency <= 450ms, total 5xx rate < 0.8%, and a drift check: model quality delta <= 1.5% on the persona-bench.

deploy-bot: Job queued: /deploy swap atlas-13b --mode stratified --waves 3 --start 2026-03-23T02:00Z --notify #eng-releases

maya: I'll take wave1 watch (02:00-02:30 UTC). ops-agent will be secondary. Can we add a 20-minute settle after each wave instead of 30? We want quicker iteration.

ops-agent: Settles at 20m ok. I'll post wave start/end one-liners and alert on: 3m spike alert, 15m sustained breach, and a coverage check if sample size < 500 requests for the persona-bench.

sam: Fallback ladder proposal: atlas-13b-quant -> atlas-13b-fp16 -> atlas-9b (quality drop). Note: prefer local-region fallbacks first, then cross-region if capacity constrained.

leo: Agreed on ladder. Also add a 'soft-latch' behavior for enterprise customers: keep them pinned to fp16 until wave 3 unless explicit opt-in.

pasha: On rollback semantics — propose a single command we can run from PD that both pins catalog and aborts job, e.g. 
```
# circuit-pin rollback
/catalog pin atlas-13b -> atlas-9b --reason "auto-circuit-pinned"
/deploy abort --job-id <job>
```
If automated detection sees p95 and 5xx breached together for 15 minutes in wave1, it should auto-pin + abort. For waves 2/3, require 2-ack manual abort unless it's a P1 (>=1% of traffic 5xx and customer-impacting).

deploy-bot: Pre-deploy checks: model artifact v2026-03-21T22:40 present, region capacity checks passed in us-east-1/us-west-2, canary lanes configured, enterprise_pin=atlas-13b-fp16 until wave=3. Dry run ok.

maya: Two small asks: 1) include a quick smoke test that runs sample prompts from the persona-bench after each wave (ops-agent), 2) document where CS can see the heads-up (send to #cs-prod-alerts and email).

ops-agent: Will run smoke: sampler size 600 across 3 personas, check token-level perplexity delta < 2% and top-doc rerank alignment. Posting runbook snippet for a fast pinback below.

leo: Put the runbook in the release notes. Also let's add a short change window note: quiet-hours block from 01:30-03:30 UTC for related infra changes.

ops-agent: Runbook snippet:
```
# fast pinback + abort
/catalog pin atlas-13b@v2 -> catalog:atlas-9b@v1 --reason "stratified auto-rollback"
/deploy abort --job-id gw-20260323-3532109999
/alerts acknowledge --by team ops
```
I'll keep that in a pinned doc and add it to the on-call playbook.

pasha: One more: add a telemetry gate that verifies sampling includes at least 10% enterprise traffic unless enterprise is enterprise_exempt (we will be exempt until wave 3). This prevents blind spots.

sam: Confirming: enterprise_exempt=true for waves 1-2; enterprise_optin channel will get a manual opt-in form.

leo: Final checklist (I'll own release notes): 1) Runbook & pinback snippet (leo + ops-agent) 2) Wave owners (maya primary, ops-agent secondary) 3) Telemetry gates wired into deploy-bot (pasha) 4) Enterprise-exempt lane config (sam) 5) Dry-run & capacity prechecks (deploy-bot) 6) Post-wave smoke tests (ops-agent).

deploy-bot: Swap created: job-id=gw-20260323-3532109999. Will post status messages at each lifecycle event in-thread. :satellite:

maya: I'll be online for the window and will update thread with a short note at wave boundaries. Please keep PD alert routing to ops team.

leo: Thanks everyone — quick pre-launch sync 01:45 UTC. Drop any last minute objections here; otherwise we proceed with the scheduled swap. :thumbsup:
